Done. Both deliverables are in `baseline/out/`, and they cross-check clean.

## What I built

The three points you gave aren't parallel facts — they're a chain (收 → 定价 → 引流), and that shaped the whole skeleton. Parallel lists don't get remembered on Douyin; chains do. So each point got its own numbered segment with an independent memory hook, and the closing segment re-closes them into the "循环" your topic promises.

**`骨架.md`** — a 68-second, 9:16, 15-shot script broken into seven segments:

| 段 | 时间 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | 0–4s | 数字反差钩子：「你家阳台上那捆卖不掉的书，我一天能收四百斤」 |
| P1 | 4–12s | 痛点：不是书不值钱，是你只有「挂闲鱼」一个选项 |
| P2 | 12–26s | ① 踩学期末（6月/1月两个窗口，溢价 3–5 倍，提前三周谈定点） |
| P3 | 26–41s | ② 破损不是砍价是重新定价（A/S/B/C 四档 + 三个硬指标） |
| P4 | 41–55s | ③ 书是入场券不是商品（换咖啡券/花束做换书市集） |
| P5 | 55–62s | 闭环合成 + 金句「收进来是本事，转出去才是本事」 |
| P6 | 62–68s | 单一 CTA：评论区打「回收」领三张定价表 |

Each segment carries 口播原文 / 画面 / 景别 / 字幕 / 音效 / 互动 / 设计理由, plus 3 alternate hooks for A/B, cover, 4 title options, hashtags, subtitle rules, compliance risks, and a reuse template.

**`structure.json`** — the same data machine-readable: 7 sections with start/end/duration, 7-beat timeline, `point_coverage` mapping each brief point to its section, plus interaction/risk/checklist/review-metric arrays.

## Verification

Rather than asserting the pacing numbers, I computed them and wrote them into the file: 328 字 total across 68s, per-section 4.00–5.43 字/秒 (all inside a comfortable口播 range), timeline contiguous 0→68s, all 7 voiceover lines present verbatim in the Markdown, and all 3 brief points mapped one-to-one to P2/P3/P4. Check output was PASS.

Two judgment calls worth flagging: I gave each point equal14–15s rather than weighting by importance, and the CTA's hook object (三张定价表) is one each of the three points' own artifacts — so the reward for commenting recaps the whole video.
